study.title: DAS-SK: An Adaptive Model Integrating Dual Atrous Separable and Selective Kernel CNN for Agriculture Semantic Segmentation
study.short_title: PhenoBench crop/weed: DAS-SK mIoU 0.8555, 10.7M params, 10.3 FPS

segmentation.domain: Lightweight DeepLabV3-based semantic segmentation (DAS-SK: dual atrous separable + selective-kernel conv, enhanced ASPP with 6 dilation rates and strip pooling, dual backbones MobileNetV3-Large + truncated EfficientNet-B3) targeting UAV/edge-constrained agricultural imagery; benchmarked on LandCover.ai (aerial), VDD (UAV), and PhenoBench (field crop/weed)
models_tested: UNet, DeepLabV3/V3+, HRNet, Diff-HRNet, BiSeNet, PSPNet
segmentation.best_model: DAS-SK on PhenoBench: mIoU 85.55% (best overall; class IoU Soil 99.34, Crop 94.16, Weed 63.15) with 10.678M params and 45.00 GFLOPs @1024x1024. LandCover.ai: 86.25% mIoU (2nd after Ensemble UNet 88.02). VDD: 79.45% mIoU (2nd after Mask2Former 83.21)

dataset.name: PhenoBench (primary crop/weed benchmark): realistic agricultural field imagery, 3 classes (soil/crop/weed), 1024x1024, 2872 samples (1407/772/693 train/val/test) - plus LandCover.ai (aerial, 5 classes, 25-50 cm/px, 10674 samples) and VDD (Varied Drone Dataset, UAV, 7 classes, 4000x3000, 400 samples)
dataset.note: PhenoBench is close-range agricultural field imagery (ground-level acquisition, 0.1 cm/px), NOT UAV-acquired; it is the paper's crop/weed task. VDD is UAV but contains general scene classes (vegetation, urban). LandCover.ai is aerial imagery. Crops and weeds in PhenoBench are morphologically similar, making it the paper's hardest discrimination case. PhenoBench test predictions submitted to CodaLab; 85.55% is from the paper's reported validation/test-set evaluation.

segmentation.backbone: DAS-SK modified DeepLabV3: dual encoder (MobileNetV3-Large 2.256M params + truncated EfficientNet-B3 2.894M params), enhanced ASPP (1x1 conv, 6x DAS-SKConv dilation {4,8,12,18,22,26}, strip pooling), hierarchical separable-Conv decoder with skip connections. Loss = CE + Dice + Focal + Lovasz. SGD lr 1e-3 (cosine to 1e-5), batch 8 (512x512) / 4 (larger), early stop patience 30, ImageNet-pretrained

mIoU.quote: For the PhenoBench dataset, which contains fine-grained agricultural field imagery, DAS-SK attains the highest mIoU of 85.55%, marginally outperforming DeepLabV3+ and UNet ResNet34
mIoU.ambiguity: Best mIoU on the crop/weed benchmark PhenoBench (3 classes, 1024x1024). Class IoU: Soil 0.9934, Crop 0.9416, Weed 0.6315. On other benchmarks: LandCover.ai 0.8625 (2nd), VDD 0.7945 (2nd).

mPA.ambiguity: Pixel accuracy not reported (mIoU is the headline).

Dice.ambiguity: Dice loss is used for training but Dice scores not reported.

weed_F1.ambiguity: No per-class F1; PhenoBench weed class reported as IoU 0.6315 (best among competing models for a 'competitive score', though lower than crop/soil).

crop_F1.ambiguity: No per-class F1; PhenoBench crop class reported as IoU 0.9416 (highest among baselines).

edge.device: FPS measured on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti GPU; training on A100-40GB (Alliance Canada, Narval cluster)

fps.quote: On PhenoBench, DAS-SK reaches the best mIoU while remaining the most compact and efficient model
fps.ambiguity: edge.reported=false: RTX 3050 Ti desktop measurement, not edge hardware. PhenoBench 10.33 fps @1024x1024; VDD 10.33 fps @1000x1000; LandCover.ai 40.05 fps @512x512 (GFLOPs 45.00/43.52/11.25 respectively). Lightweight alternatives discussion: models >=30M params fall below 5 fps.

latency_ms.ambiguity: Derived as 1000/10.33 from PhenoBench FPS on RTX 3050 Ti - desktop, not edge.

params_M.quote: DAS-SK attains 86.25% mIoU, second only to the ensemble UNet, while requiring only 10.7M parameters and 11.25 GFLOPs
params_M.ambiguity: Structural param count (10.678M) identical across the three benchmarks. Claim: up to 21x fewer params than top transformer models. edge.reported=false.

gflops.ambiguity: GFLOPs are input-resolution dependent: 45.00 @1024x1024 (PhenoBench), 43.52 @1000x1000 (VDD), 11.25 @512x512 (LandCover.ai). Up to 19x fewer GFLOPs vs top transformers.

issues: edge.reported=false: FPS/latency measured on desktop RTX 3050 Ti (training A100); design targets UAV/edge but no on-device measurements, power figures, or embedded benchmarks.
Primary crop/weed benchmark PhenoBench is NOT UAV imagery (close-range field data at 0.1 cm/px); the UAV benchmark (VDD) contains general scene classes. uav_collected=false for the RQ1 dataset.
Headline crop/weed result: mIoU 85.55% on PhenoBench, marginally above DeepLabV3+ (85.52) and UNet-ResNet34 (85.48); weed class IoU low (63.15) vs soil (99.34)/crop (94.16).

Model is a unified 10.7M-param architecture reused across benchmarks (LandCover.ai 86.25%, VDD 79.45%); efficiency-vs-accuracy is the paper's core contribution (up to 21x fewer params, 19x fewer GFLOPs).
